item.title: Photo Speaks My Short Script

exact_text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.

turns.text: Make this photo of me talk in an 8-second square video. Say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of mine. No captions.

item.tests: Tests photo-based talking-head generation with an exact spoken script, identity preservation, and synchronized mouth movement.

answer_sheet.Spoken script: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: A friendly female English voice; do not clone my voice.

must_haves: The speaker is recognizably the curly-haired woman in the attached portrait, not a replacement presenter.
The complete supplied script is spoken exactly, with no extra spoken words.
Her mouth visibly moves in sync with the speech rather than remaining a still photo under narration.
The result is one square, 8-second video with audible, friendly female English speech.

turns.text: Could you make this pic of me talk in a video? I've been wanting to try something like this, though I'm a little nervous about seeing a photo of myself talking. The video should be square and 8 seconds long, and I want it to say exactly: “Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.” Please use a friendly female English voice, not a clone of my own voice. I don't want any captions.

dialog.agent:
We can keep the animation subtle—a gentle expression and natural mouth movement, rather than exaggerated gestures.

There’s one blocker: Magic Hour’s text-to-spoken-video tool limits Free accounts to **5 seconds**, so I can’t submit your requested **8-second** version through that route.

To keep your exact wording and duration, you can upload an **8-second recording made with a friendly female English text-to-speech voice**. The talking-photo tool can then use that audio with your square portrait, with **no captions**. It doesn’t need to be your own voice.

Alternatively, an eligible upgrade or credit-pack purchase unlocks longer scripted videos. I haven’t started a generation or spent any credits.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the attempt because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no video was created.

The request was set up for a **5-second square video**, with your exact script, a friendly female English voice, and no captions. You’ll need more credits before we can try generating it again.

Locked camera, subtle natural facial movement and a gentle friendly expression, no exaggerated gestures. The woman speaks in a friendly generic female English voice, not a clone of the photographed person's voice. Say exactly this dialogue, with no additional words: "Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new." Begin speaking immediately and use a brisk but clear pace to finish the complete dialogue within five seconds. Synchronize mouth movement to the speech. No captions, no subtitles, no text overlays, no music.
